```artifact
Feature: Patient Appointment Management

  Scenario: Query on Patient Id, Patient details are displayed and can be modified
    Given a patient with id "PAT-001" and pin-code "1234"
    When the user queries the patient by id "PAT-001"
    Then the patient details are displayed with pin-code "1234"
    And the pin-code cannot be modified to be outside the Zone

  Scenario: Query on Patient Id, to display Patient details and then enter details
    Given a patient with id "PAT-001" and pin-code "1234"
    When the user queries the patient by id "PAT-001"
    Then the patient details are displayed
    When the user enters speciality "Cardiology" and symptoms "Chest Pain"
    Then the patient appointment is created with speciality "Cardiology" and symptoms "Chest Pain"
    When the user requests an appointment for next day
    Then the patient appointment is created with appointment date for next day

  Scenario: Doctor sees all the workflow consultation requests and selects them one by one
    Given a doctor with id "DOC-001" and a patient with id "PAT-001"
    When the doctor queries the patient by id "PAT-001"
    Then the patient consultation requests are displayed
    When the doctor selects a consultation request
    Then the consultation request is displayed with patient details and doctor's notes

  Scenario: Doctor sees the Patient Consultation Requests and enters Diagnosis, Prescribes medicines and requests for lab tests
    Given a doctor with id "DOC-001" and a patient with id "PAT-001"
    When the doctor queries the patient by id "PAT-001"
    Then the patient consultation requests are displayed
    When the doctor enters diagnosis "Heart Attack"
    Then the diagnosis is recorded
    When the doctor prescribes medicines "Aspirin" and "Ibuprofen"
    Then the medicines are recorded with maximum 8 medicines
    When the doctor requests lab tests "Blood Test" and "ECG"
    Then the lab tests are recorded with maximum 5 lab tests

  Scenario: Chemist sees all the workflow consultation requests and selects them one by one
    Given a chemist with id "CHE-001" and a patient with id "PAT-001"
    When the chemist queries the patient by id "PAT-001"
    Then the patient consultation requests are displayed
    When the chemist selects a consultation request
    Then the consultation request is displayed with patient details and chemist's notes

  Scenario: Chemist sees the Prescription, dispenses medicines and marks the flag in Prescription
    Given a chemist with id "CHE-001" and a patient with id "PAT-001"
    When the chemist queries the patient by id "PAT-001"
    Then the patient consultation requests are displayed
    When the chemist views the prescription
    Then the prescription is displayed with patient details and doctor's notes
    When the chemist dispenses medicines "Aspirin" and "Ibuprofen"
    Then the medicines are dispensed and the flag is marked in the prescription

  Scenario: Lab sees all the workflow consultation requests and selects them one by one
    Given a lab with id "LAB-001" and a patient with id "PAT-001"
    When the lab queries the patient by id "PAT-001"
    Then the patient consultation requests are displayed
    When the lab selects a consultation request
    Then the consultation request is displayed with patient details and lab's notes

  Scenario: Lab sees the Prescription, notes the lab tests to be done and the Patient details and marks the flag in prescription
    Given a lab with id "LAB-001" and a patient with id "PAT-001"
    When the lab queries the patient by id "PAT-001"
    Then the patient consultation requests are displayed
    When the lab views the prescription
    Then the prescription is displayed with patient details and doctor's notes
    When the lab notes the lab tests to be done "Blood Test" and "ECG"
    Then the lab tests are recorded with patient details and the flag is marked in the prescription
    When the lab adds the report
    Then the report is added with patient details and lab's notes
```
